problem_statement: Build a brand-new Product Announcements page at the route /announcements on this Material Tailwind dashboard site. The route does not exist yet (it renders blank). Construct the full page from scratch inside the site's existing dashboard shell (Sidenav + DashboardNavbar + Footer) reusing the @material-tailwind/react design system. The page has a gradient-gray page header titled 'Product Announcements' with a short intro paragraph, followed by a static list of three release entries. Each entry shows a category chip, a date, an h3 title, a body paragraph, and an author byline. This is a static informational page with no interactive controls.
required_content: Dashboard shell reused (Sidenav + DashboardNavbar + Footer) around the new page
Gradient-gray page header card titled 'Product Announcements' (h3) with a megaphone icon
Intro paragraph mentioning the latest features, improvements, and fixes
Announcement entry 'Customizable Dashboard Widgets' (Feature, July 18 2026) with body and Product Team byline
Announcement entry 'Faster Table Rendering' (Improvement, July 11 2026) with body and Platform Team byline
Announcement entry 'Two-Factor Authentication' (Security, July 3 2026) with two-factor authentication body and Security Team byline
Category chip + date + author byline on each entry
Responsive layout: entries stack cleanly on mobile with no horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse @material-tailwind/react components (Card, CardHeader, CardBody, Typography, Chip, Avatar) and heroicons
Reuse the dashboard blue-gray color tokens and the gradient-gray CardHeader used elsewhere in the site
Mount as a top-level /announcements route inside the dashboard layout shell
Static content only — no state, no toggles, no interaction (T1)

Palette/typography: use the Material Tailwind blue-gray tokens (blue-gray-500 #607D8B for accents/borders, blue-gray-100 #CFD8DC / #B0BEC5 for the gradient-gray CardHeader), a near-white page background (#ffffff / #f5f7f8), and the Roboto sans-serif font used across the dashboard.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline has empty top-level Route path='/announcements' element={<></>} (renders blank, no catch-all redirect); reference fully implements the page inside a reused dashboard shell; bad removes the announcement-list section (only header card renders) → fails dom_assertions on the three entry h3 titles + entry bodies. Three workspace source trees md5-distinct.
